people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.
translations.bsb: But Moses was angry with the officers of the army—the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds—who were returning from the battle.
translations.kjv: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.
translations.asv: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.
